question: Who is NOT a spiritual leader of the Siddis?
solution:
The correct answer is Gulam Ali.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage mentions the spiritual leaders of the Siddis: Bava Gor, Mai Misra, Baba Habash, and Sidi Nabi Sultan.
 
• **Gulam Ali is not mentioned** as a spiritual leader of the Siddis in the passage.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Baba Habash** - A spiritual leader mentioned in the passage.
 
• **Mai Misra** - A spiritual leader mentioned in the passage.
 
• **Sidi Nabi Sultan** - A spiritual leader mentioned in the passage.
